sloka: तेषु तेषु महार्हेषु भवनेषु महायशाः ।गृहेष्वृद्धिमतामृद्धिं ददाह स महाकपिः ।। 5.54.17 ।।।।
transliteration: teṣu teṣu mahārheṣu bhavaneṣu mahāyaśāḥ ।gṛheṣvṛddhimatāmṛddhiṁ dadāha sa mahākapiḥ ।। 5.54.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Moving among those highly luxurious mansions the glorious Vanara burnt away the wealth of all the rich demons.
